page.content:
Bait-and-switch to Rick Astley's 1987 video 'Never Gonna Give You Up.'

How Rickroll connects

  • Work: Never Gonna Give You Up — A rickroll plays Never Gonna Give You Up as the punchline.
  • Topic: Viral video — The rickroll is a bait-and-switch viral-video meme.
  • Location: 4chan — The rickroll spread from 4chan before it hit the wider web.
  • Work: Know Your Meme — Know Your Meme's rickroll entry is a standard origin write-up.
  • Work: YTMND — YTMND's forced loops trained the bait-and-replay habit the rickroll perfected.

What is Rickroll?

The rickroll, spreading from 4chan in 2007, disguised a link as something else and played Astley's clip. It is the canonical bait meme of the late 2000s.

Key threads lead to Never Gonna Give You Up, Viral video, 4chan, Know Your Meme and YTMND.
